services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From a single room repaint to full house redecoration, we handle interior and exterior work with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork painted to a professional finish. We prep surfaces properly and use quality paints that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior. We handle fascias, soffits, doors, and render, with expert prep and weather-resistant finishes.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert hanging of wallpaper and feature walls. We pattern-match perfectly and work around obstacles with care.

services.title: Woodwork and Doors
services.desc: Internal and external doors, skirting boards, and architraves painted to a smooth, durable finish.

services.title: Feature Walls and Accent Colours
services.desc: Create a focal point or refresh a room with bold colour. We'll advise on colour schemes and execute the work flawlessly.

services.title: Full House Redecoration
services.desc: Comprehensive interior refresh—multiple rooms, ceilings, and woodwork. We manage the job start to finish with minimal disruption.

about_pullquote: We turn up on time, do the job right, and leave your home clean.
about_para_1: Sean and Mo set up their painting and decorating business in Manchester over 15 years ago with a simple aim: deliver honest, reliable work at a fair price. They've built a loyal customer base across the city by turning up when promised, taking pride in every finish, and treating every home with respect.
about_para_2: Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a full house redecoration, they bring the same attention to detail and professionalism. Customers return to Sean and Mo because they know exactly what to expect: quality work, no hidden costs, and a team that listens to what you want.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Sean & Mo

reviews.text: Had our lounge and kitchen done. Sean and Mo were brilliant—turned up on time, worked steadily, and the finish was spot on. They moved furniture carefully and cleaned up after themselves every day. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Richard T.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior of our terraced house painted before winter. They did the lot—fascias, doors, and a full wall repaint. Honest lads, fair price, and the work's held up beautifully so far. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Wallpapered our hallway and feature wall after we got a bit stuck. Professional job, no mess, and they took time to explain what they were doing. Made it look effortless. Top marks.
reviews.author: Michael K.
